$comment: Uptime monitors for staging (spec 01 §8.4, spec 08 §7.6): every 60 s from us and eu, email only through staging-quiet. host names a host role; the real hostname comes from the deploy configuration at apply time and is never committed. The secret monitor header's value is read from FIN_MONITOR_HEADER_FILE at apply time and lives only in Better Stack. The keyword csp-nonce is the meta tag every built index.html carries (static:check), so it proves the static half answered with the app shell. api-canary waits for API keys (spec 01 §8.4): api-health stands in until then.

monitors.name: api-health
monitors.proves: the public tunnel, the edge and its readiness

monitors.name: api-unauthenticated
monitors.proves: the edge refuses a call with no key (the errors/unauthenticated keyword joins once SP-06 shows a keyword check can expect a 401)

monitors.name: console-sign-in
monitors.proves: the console's static half (its assets-only deployment)

monitors.name: console-api-health
monitors.proves: the console's /api/* route with no Worker, the tunnel and the API half

monitors.name: verify-api-health
monitors.proves: the verify host's /api/* route, the tunnel and the verify API half

monitors.name: admin
monitors.proves: Access stands in front of Fin Admin (a 302 to the Access sign-in, redirects not followed)
